name: Self-Mutilation
body:
With the advantages offered by magical prosthetics, you see no reason to settle for your natural limbs.

Prerequisite: Con 15.

Benefit: You can willingly sever your own arms, feet, hands, and legs. Doing so deals 1d3 Constitution damage but otherwise follows the normal rules for severing limbs.
